UpdateStageName: Prepare S1DS data directories and environment file
UpdateSourceArgs:
-c "mkdir -p '{{$FullRootDir}}game' '{{$FullRootDir}}steamcmd' '{{$FullRootDir}}steamhome'; setfacl -R -m u:1000:rwX -m d:u:1000:rwX -m u:$(id -u):rwX -m d:u:$(id -u):rwX '{{$FullRootDir}}game' '{{$FullRootDir}}steamcmd' '{{$FullRootDir}}steamhome' 2>/dev/null || true; printf 'S1DS_RUNTIME=%s
STEAM_USER=%s
STEAM_PASS=%s
STEAM_GUARD=%s
FORCE_STEAMCMD_UPDATE=false
' '{{Runtime}}' '{{SteamUser}}' '{{SteamPass}}' '{{SteamGuard}}' > '{{$FullRootDir}}s1ds.env' && chmod 600 '{{$FullRootDir}}s1ds.env'"
